brief: The 6 tools a solo founder uses to ship like a funded team — no hires, no investors, no excuses.

slots.insight1Body: Cursor reads your entire repo, not just the open file.

slots.insight3Body: It already knows your style guide and dependencies.
slots.pullQuote: My senior engineer never sleeps, never equity-vests, and costs sixteen dollars a month.

slots.title: Deploy at
slots.subtitle: Infrastructure that auto-scales so you never touch a server config.
slots.insight1Body: Serve static assets from the node nearest your customer.
slots.insight2Body: Every push generates a live URL for instant stakeholder review.

slots.ctaBody: Ship faster, spend less, and own the entire stack. The solo founder's advantage is focus, not funding.
